description: This file defines a Python class 'MeteredStream' that implements a stream wrapper with 'meter' functionality for progress display, along with a custom logging handler '_LogHandler'. It includes methods for writing, erasing, and throttling output, and manages logging integration.

classes.name: MeteredStream
classes.description: A stream wrapper that supports progress meters and logging integration.

classes.name: _LogHandler
classes.description: Custom logging handler that writes log records to a MeteredStream instance.

methods.name: _erasure
methods.description: Returns a string that erases the given text from the terminal line.

methods.name: _ensure_newline
methods.description: Ensures the given text ends with a newline character.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes a MeteredStream with optional stream, verbosity, logger, timing, process ID, and column width.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes the log handler from the logger.

methods.name: write_throttled_update
methods.description: Writes an update if the throttle delay has passed.

methods.name: write_update
methods.description: Writes a text update, optionally updating the last partial line.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes text to the stream with optional timestamp and process ID, handling verbosity and terminal capabilities.

methods.name: writeln
methods.description: Writes a line with a newline appended.

methods.name: _erase_last_partial_line
methods.description: Erases the last partial line from the terminal.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes the stream, ensuring the last partial line is completed.

methods.name: number_of_columns
methods.description: Returns the number of columns for terminal output.
